rationale: Ground truth is essentially an LGTM approval with no substantive inline concerns (plus an unrelated ask to split out a VoxCPM2 fix, which neither candidate addresses). Both candidates did solid, well-grounded mechanism verification of the seed-removal fix and proposed reasonable, non-fabricated 'add a guard comment/test' suggestions. Y's final verdict (APPROVE) matches the actual outcome and frames its suggestions as optional/non-blocking, closer to reality; X escalates to a 'COMMENT' verdict with three findings (including a speculative dead-code note) that read as more thorough but overshoot what the real reviewers cared about. Neither recovers the VoxCPM2 ground-truth comment, so recall is low for both.
